libs.note: BH-9937 (BH-9926 wave 5): the per-PR wake gate. A lane in step record (lane.<id>.gh_source, bin/lib/prr-shadow.sh) stops reading a PR that had no `pr` wake (key = the number) and no `checks` wake (key = the head sha) since its last read. The marks are a cache in state/prr-seen/<lane>/<repo>.tsv, bounded to the repo's open PRs. Used by pr-state-reconcile and main-red-pr-pair; the blocked-resolver and unblock waves reuse it.

knobs.note: BH-9937. The longest a lane in step record goes without reading a PR that had no wake: a mark older than this reads the PR again (the backstop for a lost webhook). wb_due (bin/lib/wake-backstop.sh) reads 1..1799 as 1800, its floor. 0 = the gate is off and every PR is read every tick. Read in bin/lib/prr-seen.sh as PRR_SEEN_BACKSTOP_S, code fallback 1800.
